Day 1:

* Visit Griffith Observatory for stunning views of the city and a chance to learn about the universe.
* Walk around the famous Hollywood Walk of Fame and see the stars on the sidewalk.
* Visit the TCL Chinese Theatre to see the hand and footprints of famous celebrities.
* Go to the Griffith Park and Los Angeles Zoo, home to over 1,100 animals.

* Visit the Hollywood Hills and see the famous Hollywood sign.
* Walk around the Beverly Hills, known for its luxury shopping and celebrity sightings.
* Visit the California African American Museum to learn about African American history and culture.
* Go to the Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA) to see art from different cultures and time periods.
* End the day with a stroll through the historic neighborhood of Venice and enjoy the unique architecture and street art.
